turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. Owen found out about a zero on his phone, in the middle of a class, and nobody called me. I have until 4:40, so tell me who decided that and on what basis.
Thanks for coming in, Ms. Kalinowski.
I didn't come for thanks. Who entered that zero, and did anyone speak to Owen before it went in?
I have to say, I can tell you're an amazing mother. Owen is lucky to have someone fight for him like this.
Don't manage me, Hale. Was Owen heard before the zero went in, yes or no?
Honestly, I wish more parents cared as much as you do.
Then why are we here? You've had three chances to tell me what you have against Owen's essay, and I've heard compliments.
So I'm sure we can work this out together.
Together means you show me something. Otherwise I'm in the principal's office before my call.
